items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: You probably know Sidney DeParis too and Wilbur DeParis. That's right. Sure. They're playing fine today.

ctx.x: got a break. He's doing all right now. Jonah's playing the same trumpet now that he was playing then. Only then he was playing more than what he's playing now. Yeah, the same thing is true of Sidney DeParis. You probably know Sidney DeParis too and Wilbur DeParis. That's right. Sure. They're playing fine today. Finally getting a little recognition to him. That's right. Well, Jonah deserves it. He's a good man. Sure he does. Is there anything you'd like to add
about the Keyhole Club or when you organized that? Well, the Keyhole first came into being in 1944
